 - Drive revenue from technology integrations through partner-driven customer acquisition, product consumption, expansion, retention, co-sell opportunities, and commercial arrangements.

 - Own the commercial performance of the technology partnerships and marketplace portfolio, including forecasting and reporting on progress, risks, and return on investment.

 - Build and deepen relationships with AI labs, working closely with their product, engineering, business development, and executive teams to identify and execute high-impact partnership opportunities.

 - Develop executive relationships with strategic partners across developer tools, cloud, and adjacent infrastructure.

 - Lead or support negotiations for complex partnerships, including integration, referral, revenue-sharing, and joint go-to-market agreements.

 - Help partner managers build joint business plans that connect partner priorities to measurable outcomes for Supabase and its customers.


LEAD THE MARKETPLACE TEAM

 - Lead and develop the Marketplace team, setting its commercial and partner strategy and holding the team accountable for outcomes.

 - Guide the team in identifying the capabilities developers need, recruiting the right partners, and helping those partners launch and grow.

 - Set priorities and allocate resources across strategic, high-touch partners and scalable paths for emerging and self-serve partners.

 - Ensure the team works effectively with Product and Engineering on integration quality, partner onboarding, discovery, activation, and the developer experience across product surfaces.

 - Enable the team to work with Marketing and Sales to launch integrations, enable teams, and drive ongoing adoption—not just announcements.


OPERATE WITH RIGOR

 - Establish clear measures for partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, integration adoption, revenue, consumption, retention, and marketplace performance.

 - Work with Finance, Data, and Partner Operations to improve attribution, reporting, forecasting, and partner revenue processes.

 - Represent the voice of partners and customers in product and go-to-market planning, while aligning stakeholders around shared priorities.

 - Identify risks early, remove blockers, and communicate decisions and outcomes clearly to leadership.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Have significant experience in technology partnerships, business development, or ecosystem leadership at a developer tools, cloud, infrastructure, or SaaS company.

 - Have led and developed partner-facing teams, including managers or senior individual contributors, and can balance strategic direction with hands-on execution.

 - Have a track record of building partnerships that produced measurable revenue, product adoption, or customer growth.

 - Have negotiated complex commercial agreements and understand partnership economics, including revenue share, referrals, and consumption-based models.

 - Have worked closely with Product and Engineering to ship and grow technical integrations. You can engage credibly with technical teams, including those at AI labs, even if you aren’t the person writing the code.

 - Know how to build relationships with executives while earning the trust of product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.

 - Use data to prioritize opportunities, assess partner performance, and make decisions when attribution is imperfect.

 - Are comfortable building in an evolving environment, communicating in writing, and working asynchronously across time zones.


IT’S A PLUS IF YOU HAVE

 - Built or scaled a developer marketplace, integration ecosystem, or partner platform.

 - Worked with AI LLMs, AI app builders, databases, open-source products, or developer infrastructure.

 - A background in software development, with an understanding of how developers build and integrate products.

 - Experience growing both a small number of strategic partnerships and a broader, scalable partner program.

 - A strong network in the San Francisco Bay Area technology ecosystem.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to take ownership of vendor contracting at Supabase. You will be the go-to contracts partner for everything we buy.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with real ownership, for an experienced negotiator who takes pride in making procurement faster while managing risk. You will negotiate directly, build the playbooks and workflows that let the business self-serve on low-risk deals, and escalate the right issues to Legal at the right time. We work AI-first in Legal: you will use Claude and Ironclad every day to move faster and with greater accuracy. Your work will shape how procurement and vendor contracting scale as Supabase grows.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters.

 - Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk.

 - Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it.

 - Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes.

Build and scale vendor contracting operations

 - Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks.

 - Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps.

 - Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks.

 - Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler.

 - Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information.

Preferred

 - A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree.

 - Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side.

 - Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a similar CLM tool (Juro, Docusign CLM) or building AI-assisted legal workflows, ideally with some exposure to AI governance.

A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role   Our team of Administrative Business Partners does more than just support our leaders: we're the backbone of the busiest people at Palantir. We build positive relationships with the people we support and anticipate their needs without being asked. Our passion for helping others makes us an invaluable resource at Palantir! As an Administrative Business Partner, you will be handling a variety of professional responsibilities, including calendaring, travel, and expenses. You are very organized and thrive off of enabling the people we support to be as productive and impactful as possible. You'll demonstrate your excellent communication skills, and exercise tact and diplomacy in helping to manage relationships with internal and external senior team members at Palantir. In this role you'll also demonstrate good judgment and critical thinking by understanding competing priorities and actioning accordingly. Administrative Business Partner (Foundry)
  • Provide administrative support to a portfolio of individuals/teams across the business.
  • Handle sophisticated calendars in a fast-paced environment, and prioritize commitments to enhance time and productivity.
  • Book travel arrangements (domestic and international).
  • Track and process expense reports.
  • Help plan, support, and complete office events and external gatherings.
  • Work both autonomously and in collaboration with teammates, colleagues, and external contacts.
    • What We Value
  • Ability to adjust quickly, anticipate needs, and implement autonomously, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to interact with a wide range of teams internally and externally with thoughtfulness and tact.
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and discretion in both internal and external interactions.
    • What We Require
  • At least three years of previous administrative or personal support experience, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent digital literacy, including proficiency with Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Experience with scheduling sophisticated international and domestic travel itineraries.
  • Familiarity with travel booking and expense reporting software.
    • Palantir is particularly interested in applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and we encourage Singapore citizens to apply. Life at Palantir   We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.   In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.   If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.   Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, power decisions on the battlefield, locate missing children, and more.   Applications for the January 2027 cohort are open now through December 11, 2026.   The Program   In the 20th century, America pioneered mass production. We built the Arsenal of Democracy and won the war. Then we left this mighty Arsenal to rust. Silicon Valley, a product of Heartland work ethic, turned its back on the American worker. It's time to reawaken the giant. The same spirit of practical innovation that enabled America to dominate the previous century lives on in every American factory, workshop, and garage today. Some fear the proliferation of Artificial Intelligence, but we see the opportunity for a technological and industrial renaissance. Palantir is launching the American Tech Fellowship to arm Americans with the skills to deploy cutting-edge software in the workforce. You will have an opportunity to explore and build on Palantir's Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) and earn a professional certification in its use. Exceptional performers will earn an opportunity to interview for a role at Palantir or partner companies, where you can use your newfound skills to contribute to the revival of American industry. This fellowship is about more than careers. It's about restoring the promise that hard work and determination can still change your life in America. It's an investment in American excellence, and evidence of our belief that America's greatest builders are still to be discovered. The American worker, given the right tools and opportunity, remains our competitive advantage. It's time to prove it.   The Role   In this fellowship, you'll participate in a comprehensive training program with our partner, Ontologize, to level up your technical skills on Foundry and AIP. You'll learn how to deploy Palantir's advanced software to solve tough problems in enterprise settings and have the opportunity to engage directly with Palantir engineers and leadership. The fellowship runs for 12 weeks, beginning on January 13, 2027. You are expected to attend live virtual sessions on two weeknights each week. We will also have optional sessions once a week and office hours throughout the duration of the program. Expect to spend 10 to 15 hours per week on instruction and project work throughout the fellowship. This program provides valuable training to participants and is unpaid. The window for submitting American Tech Fellowship applications is now through December 11, 2026.   What We’re Looking For
We want builders: people who are hungry to learn whatever it takes to succeed and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves and make it happen.

You might be that kind of person if you've taught yourself, or been the local go-to, in one or more of these areas:
  • Software, data, or automation
  • General-purpose programming languages such as Python, C/C++, C# / .NET, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Data science applications such as SQL, MATLAB, Simulink, R, Julia, Excel + VBA
  • Process improvements like instrumenting, automating, or optimizing how things run
  • Prototyping—i.e., testing ideas iteratively instead of waiting for perfect specs
    • What We Value
    Show us where you've flexed that builder's mindset. That could look like:
  • Formal study in computer science, electrical/mechanical/control systems engineering, physics, applied math, data science, mechatronics, robotics, or a related field
  • Experience solving real problems in settings such as a factory floor, a warehouse or logistics hub, a hospital or clinic, a construction site, field service, energy or utility operations, the military, a small business, or a garage shop, especially if you automated, instrumented, or optimized a process
  • Startup, maker-space, or hackathon projects that blended hardware and software, such as retrofitting equipment, building a sensor network, or deploying an edge AI model
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in software, data, automation, or related technical fields
    • If you've got the fire to learn and you've built something that moved the needle, you're the kind of American worker we designed this fellowship for.

    Backgrounds in skilled trades, manufacturing, and field work, as well as in clinical or business settings, are welcome.
    What We Require
  • 2+ years of hands-on work experience in a technical setting or engaging in on-the-job technical processes
  • Backgrounds in computer science, data science, physics, and engineering domains are preferred, though no formal degree is required.

If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

postings.content:
A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role   Backend Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations use data. Our Software Engineers are involved throughout the product lifecycle, from idea generation, design, prototyping, and production delivery. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical teammates to understand our customers' problems and build products that solve them. We encourage movement across teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different technologies and aspects of each product. Engineers work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop, becoming a strong technical contributor and engineering leader.   Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with other engineers to architect a new system that enables a novel workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency operational outcomes.   Our Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability.   We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.   Frontline   Foundry Software Engineers may be offered the opportunity to Frontline, an exclusive program unlike any other. They work in small teams to own the end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects. This spectrum ranges from discussing architecture and building custom web apps to conducting workshops with users and strategizing with customer executives. No two days are alike, as each day is diverse and impactful.   • Building robust APIs for use by front-end developers and interfacing external systems, and collaborating with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
  • Designing efficient data structures and algorithms to manage large-scale and high throughput data

You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share. Technologies We Use
  • Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs
  • Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

  • Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo.
  • Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.
  • Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms.
  • Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on.
  • Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution.
  • Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.
  • Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable.
  • Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open-source use, including its APIs, packaging, documentation, and contributor experience.

  • An ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness, security, and automated testing, including responsibility for how software behaves in production.
  • Pride in building and maintaining integrations over time, including the detailed work required to keep them reliable as upstream systems change.
  • Engineering judgment that balances delivering new capabilities with simplifying existing systems and reducing operational burden.
  • Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics.
  • Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and persistence in debugging problems across languages, APIs, services, networks, and execution environments.
    • What We Require
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience developing external system connectors, with depth in areas such as developing batch and streaming data ingestion systems, third-party integration development, or monorepo and asset distribution frameworks. Operating on top of these technologies alone does not qualify.
  • Deep expertise in Gradle, including developing custom plugins, managing multi-project builds, and optimizing build performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex reliability and performance problems and improve systems through measured, incremental changes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting and workflows as recruiting processes change

  • Proficiency integrating APIs, data warehouses, and SaaS systems
  • Familiarity with workflow automation, writeback processes, and event-driven integrations
  • Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, retention, access controls, and compliance-related workflows

  • Partner with Finance team to provide leadership with visibility of deal progress and forecasting impact.

  • Adaptive, empathetic, and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.

A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. What We're About   At its core, this role is about uncovering dots and—without knowing the shape they form—figuring out how to connect them. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.   If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.   What We Do   As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.   Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions. No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:
  • Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
  • Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
  • Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
  • Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
  • Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
  • Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
  • Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.
    • What We Value
  • We value team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers. We value the desire to dive into the details of the data because that’s the core of our work. And we value low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit.
  • Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
  • Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
  • Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.
  • Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.
    • What We Require
  • Ability to read, write, and speak fluent business Korean and English is a requirement.

Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.
 
If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.
 
What We Do
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
 
Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions.
 
No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:
 
• Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
• Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
• Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
• Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
• Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
• Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
• Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
• Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.
 
What We Value
 
• We value team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers. We value the desire to dive into the details of the data because that’s the core of our work. And we value low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit.
• Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
• Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
• Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.
• Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.
 
What We Require
 
• Fluency in Polish.
• Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance.
 
 
Life at Palantir
 

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Firma, która zmienia świat
 
W Palantirze dążymy do rozwiązywania najważniejszych i najbardziej wymagających problemów na świecie. Wierzymy, że tworzenie oprogramowania umożliwiającego podejmowanie decyzji przez ludzi jest najlepszym sposobem na osiągnięcie tego celu. Współpracujemy z najważniejszymi instytucjami na świecie, aby przeobrazić sposób, w jaki wykorzystują dane i technologię. Nasze oprogramowanie było wykorzystywane m.in. do powstrzymania ataków terrorystycznych, odkrywania nowych leków, zdobywania przewagi na globalnych rynkach finansowych.
 
Kogo szukamy
 
Nasi klienci przychodzą do nas z przeczuciem, że jedynym sposobem na ochronę ich żołnierzy, wytwarzanie wysokiej jakości produktów, budodwanie skutecznych struktur dla opieki zdrowotnej lub zapewnianie pomocy uchodźcom jest lepsze wykorzystanie danych. Deployment Strategist jest odpowiedzialny za przekucie tego przeczucia w rzeczywistość. Praca polega przede wszystkim na odkrywaniu wskazówek i określaniu sposobu ich połączenia na podstawie dostępnych informacji.
Jeśli wierzysz w transformacyjną moc danych i technologii oraz w swoją zdolność do wykorzystania tej mocy do walki ze złożonymi problemami, chcemy poznać Cię bliżej.
 
Co robimy
 
Jako Deployment Strategist będziesz pracować w ramach zaangażowanego i kreatywnego zespołu inżynierów, projektantów produktów i innych Deployment Strategists, aby wdrażać oprogramowanie w odpowiedzi na najtrudniejsze problemy, z którymi mierzy się świat. Twoja misja polega na syntetyzowaniu oddzielnych strumieni przemyśleń w celu zrozumienia jaki problem jest najważniejszy, co mówią o nim dane, czego potrzebuje produkt, co motywuje użytkowników i na jakiej płaszczyźnie można wywrzeć największy wpływ.
Deployment Strategists to osoby, które zagłębiają się w najbardziej skomplikowane procesy i zespoły naszych klientów, oraz analizują dane i wkraczają w środowisko produktów, aby umożliwić nam odpowiednie skalowanie.. Problemy, z którymi będziesz się mierzyć, będą wymagały dociekliwości i analitycznego myślenia, intuicji w zakresie budowania technicznych produktów oraz silnej empatii względem użytkowników, tak aby ostatecznie umożliwić naszym klientom podejmowanie lepszych decyzji. Określona liczba Deployment Strategists może również zostać wcielona do wewnętrznych zespołów Palantira pracujących nad wyzwaniami naszej firmy
 
Każdy dzień jest niepowtarzalny, ale jako Deployment Strategist możesz oczekiwać, że:
 
• Spotkasz się bezpośrednio z analitykami klienta, aby zrozumieć kluczowe pytania, na które muszą odpowiedzieć, aby zlokalizować najważniejsze problemy w swoich organizacjach.
• Będziesz identyfikować istotne zbiory danych poprzez głębokie zaangażowanie w problemy i procesy klientów oraz współpracę z inżynierami pierwszej linii (Forward Deployed Engineers) w celu integracji danych w obrębie stabilnego i skalowalnego procesu.
• Będziesz współpracować z klientem, aby stworzyć dopasowane do niego sposoby pracy dla nowych grup użytkowników.
• Będziesz prowadzić sesje szkoleniowe, aby upewnić się, że produkt spełnia potrzeby użytkowników i jest wykorzystywany na skalę, mającą konkretny wpływ na działalność naszych partnerów.
• Będziesz przedstawiać wyniki naszej pracy i propozycje dotyczące przyszłej pracy odbiorcom, począwszy od analityków, a skończywszy na kadrze kierowniczej najwyższego szczebla.
• Dołączysz do naszych zespołów inżynieryjnych i projektowania produktów, aby uwzględnić obserwacje z terenu w ofercie produktów Palantira.
• Będziesz tworzyć i przedstawiać prezentacje nowym i obecnym klientom.
• Będziesz rozszerzać potencjalne zaangażowanie w nowych branżach i w coraz bardziej rozwijających się lokalizacjach na całym świecie.
 
Co sobie cenimy
 
• Członków zespołu, którzy nie są zadowoleni z powierzchownych odpowiedzi. Chęć zanurzenia się w szczegóły danych –to jest podstawa naszej pracy. A także skromność, ponieważ wyniki mają większe znaczenie niż kto zdobędzie za nie uznanie.
• Niezwykłą zdolność do rozwiązywania otwartych problemów w nieustrukturyzowanych środowiskach.
• Adaptacyjne i introspektywne podejście; chęć uczenia siebie i innych, gotowość do kierowania, jak i podążania za liderami.
• Wymagana możliwość podróżowania na poziomie 25-75%. Wymóg ten różni się w zależności od lokalizacji i zespołu.
• Plusem będzie dodatkowe doświadczenie w zakresie programowania, pisania skryptów lub używania pakietów statystycznych (np. Python, R, Matlab, SQL).
 
Wymagania:
 
• Biegła znajomość języka polskiego.
• Poświadczenie bezpieczeństwa lub możliwość do jego uzyskania.
 
 
Życie w Palantir
 
Chcemy, aby każdy z pracowników firmy Palantir osiągał najlepsze wyniki, dlatego doceniamy mocne strony, umiejętności i zainteresowania poszczególnych osób od pierwszej rozmowy kwalifikacyjnej po długoterminowy rozwój, zamiast polegać na tradycyjnych drabinach kariery. Zwracanie uwagi na potrzeby naszej społeczności umożliwia nam optymalizację naszych możliwości rozwoju i pomaga zapewnić wiele dróg do sukcesu w Palantir. Promowanie zdrowia i dobrego samopoczucia we wszystkich obszarach życia pracowników firmy Palantir to tylko jeden ze sposobów inwestowania w naszą społeczność. Dowiedz się więcej na stronie Życie w Palantir i pamiętaj, że nasza oferta może się różnić w zależności od regionu.

Wierzymy, że postępowanie zgodne z wartościami i kulturą firmy Palantir sprawia, iż pracownicy „lepiej współpracują ze sobą”, a praca osobista daje możliwość bardziej kreatywnych wyników. Dlatego zachęcamy pracowników do pracy w naszych biurach, aby wspierać powiązania i innowacje. Wiele zespołów oferuje opcje hybrydowe (dzień lub dwa dni w tygodniu pracy w domu), dzięki czemu nasi pracownicy mogą uzyskać odpowiedni kompromis dla swojej osobistej produktywności. W zależności od potrzeb biznesowych istnieje kilka ról, które pozwalają na „zdalną” pracę w wyjątkowych warunkach. Jeśli ubiegasz się o jedno z tych stanowisk, musisz pracować w mieście i kraju, w którym jesteś zatrudniony. Jeśli oferta w ogłoszeniu jest określona jako „na miejscu”, musisz pracować w biurze.

Jeśli chcesz wzmacniać najważniejsze instytucje świata, jest to miejsce dla Ciebie. Palantir ceni doskonałość niezależnie od pochodzenia. Dokładamy wszelkich starań, aby proces składania aplikacji i zatrudniania był dostępny dla wszystkich, oraz zapewnimy odpowiednie udogodnienia osobom z niepełnosprawnością. Jeśli potrzebujesz udogodnienia w procesie aplikacji lub zatrudnienia, skontaktuj się z nami i daj nam znać, jak możemy Ci pomóc.

Pamiętaj, że nigdy nie zostaniesz poproszony(-a) o przesłanie płatności lub udostępnienie informacji finansowych w celu wzięcia udziału w naszym procesie rekrutacyjnym. Jeśli podejrzewasz, że skontaktował się z Tobą oszust, zalecamy zaprzestanie wszelkiej komunikacji z taką osobą i rozważenie zgłoszenia jej odpowiednim organom, takim jak amerykańskie Centrum ds. Zgłaszania Przestępstw Internetowych (IC3) przy FBI (FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.   If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.   What We Do   As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.   Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role   At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality. If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.   What We Do As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions. No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:
  • Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
  • Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
  • Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
  • Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
  • Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
  • Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
  • Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.
    • What We Value
  • We value team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers. We value the desire to dive into the details of the data because that’s the core of our work. And we value low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit.
  • Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
  • Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
  • Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.
  • Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.
    • What We Require
  • Active US Security Clearance at or above the Top Secret level.
    • Salary   The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $110,000 - $170,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives. Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.   Benefits   •  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance •  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance •  Commuter benefits •  Relocation assistance •  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based •  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs) •  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year •  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events •  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents •  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation •  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child •  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan   Life at Palantir   We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.   In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.   If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.   Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

postings.title: Deployment Strategist - Warp Speed

postings.content:
A World-Changing Company 
 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. 
The Role
 As a Deployment Strategist Intern, you'll work as part of a diverse, generative, and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most important problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. The problems you'll solve will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, an ability to speak the language of data, and an understanding that humans should make decisions.

At its core, this role is about uncovering dots and—without knowing the shape they form—figuring out how to connect them. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.

Deployment Strategists are do-ers who thrive in ambiguity, react quickly to new stimuli, and don't equate pivoting with failing as they operate in pursuit of truth, value, and meaningful impact. In this internship, you'll immerse yourself in intricate customer workflows, explore data using quantitative analytics across large datasets, and dive into the product landscape.
If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you. 
No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:
Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest struggles
Build a case for gaining access to the relevant datasets, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline
Create and lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting the needs of a range of users, and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations
Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives
Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings
Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers
Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world
What We Value
Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments
Ability to be adaptive and introspective; willingness to learn, teach, lead and follow
Ability to travel as needed. Varies by location and team
Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus
Offer Deadline
 In an effort to build more transparency into our recruitment process, we’d like to share our offer deadline expectations. By applying to this position, you commit to confirming your decision within two weeks of receiving your written offer.
Life at Palantir
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Une entreprise qui transforme le monde qui nous entoure
Palantir construit le premier logiciel au monde pour les décisions et les opérations axées sur les données. En fournissant les bonnes données aux personnes qui en ont besoin, nos plateformes permettent à nos partenaires de développer des médicaments vitaux, de prévoir les perturbations de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, de localiser les enfants disparus, etc.
Les missions proposées
En tant que stagiaire Deployment Strategist, vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe diversifiée, innovante et créative d’ingénieur(e)s, de concepteurs/conceptrices de produits et d’autres Deployment Strategists pour déployer des logiciels afin de répondre aux principaux problèmes auxquels notre monde est confronté. Votre mission est de synthétiser des flux d’idées disparates en une présentation cohérente du problème, de la signification des données, des besoins liés au produit, de ce qui motive les utilisateurs et de l’impact potentiel. Les problèmes que vous résoudrez nécessiteront de la curiosité d’esprit et un sens de l’analyse, un sens aigu des produits, la maîtrise du langage des données et la conviction que ce sont les humains doivent décider. 
 
Le poste consiste en fait à repérer des informations sans savoir à quoi elles ressemblent, puis de trouver une façon de les relier les unes aux autres. Nos clients viennent nous voir parce qu’ils pensent que la seule façon de protéger leurs collaborateurs, de fabriquer des produits de haute qualité, de structurer des politiques de santé efficaces ou d’aider les réfugiés en toute sécurité est de mieux utiliser leurs données. Les Deployment Strategists sont chargés de transformer ce sentiment en réalité. 
 
Les Deployment Strategists sont des personnes de terrain à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté, qui réagissent rapidement aux nouveaux stimuli et n’assimilent pas le fait de changer de cap à l’échec, tout en s’efforçant de trouver la vérité, la valeur et d’avoir un impact significatif. Ce stage vous conduira dans des flux de travail clients complexes : vous étudierez les données à l’aide d’analyses quantitatives sur de grands ensembles de données et découvrirez l’écosystème des produits. 
Si vous croyez au pouvoir transformationnel des données et de la technologie et à votre propre capacité à mettre ce pouvoir au service de la résolution de problèmes complexes, nous voulons vous rencontrer.
Les jours se suivent mais ne se ressemblent pas. Toutefois, en tant que Deployment Strategist, voici ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre:
Vous rendre sur site et rencontrer les analystes des clients pour comprendre les questions critiques auxquelles ils doivent répondre et cerner leurs plus grandes difficultés
Élaborer un dossier pour accéder aux ensembles de données pertinents et travailler avec les Forward Deployed Engineers pour intégrer les données dans un pipeline stable et extensible
Créer et animer des sessions de formation pour vous assurer que le produit répond aux besoins de toutes sortes d’utilisateurs et qu’il est utilisé suffisamment largement pour avoir un impact concret sur les activités de nos partenaires
Présenter les résultats de notre travail et nos propositions de travaux futurs à des publics allant des analystes aux cadres dirigeants
Travailler en collaboration avec nos équipes de Software Engineers et de Product Designers afin d’incorporer ce que vous avez vu sur le terrain dans les offres de produits transverses de Palantir
Créer et proposer des démonstrations aux nouveaux clients et aux clients existants
Évaluer les engagements potentiels dans de nouveaux secteurs et dans des sites de plus en plus nombreux à travers le monde
Le profil recherché
Capacité extraordinaire à résoudre des problèmes complexes dans des environnements non structurés
Capacité d’adaptation et d’introspection ; disposition à apprendre, à enseigner, à diriger et à suivre les instructions
Capacité à voyager selon les besoins. Varie selon l’emplacement et l’équipe
Une expérience en programmation, scripts ou packages statistiques (par ex. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) est un plus
Date limite de l’offre
Afin de renforcer la transparence de notre processus de recrutement, nous aimerions vous faire part de nos attentes concernant la date limite de l’offre. En postulant à ce poste, vous vous engagez à confirmer votre décision dans les deux semaines suivant la réception de votre offre écrite.
La vie chez Palantir
Nous tenons à ce que chaque Palantirien(ne) atteigne son meilleur potentiel, c’est pourquoi nous célébrons les forces, les compétences et les intérêts des individus, de votre premier entretien à votre croissance à long terme, plutôt que de nous appuyer sur les échelles de carrière traditionnelles. L’attention portée aux besoins de notre communauté nous permet d’optimiser nos possibilités de croissance et contribue à garantir de nombreuses voies de réussite chez Palantir. Promouvoir la santé et le bien-être dans tous les domaines de la vie des Palantiriens n’est que l’une des façons dont nous investissons dans notre communauté. Apprenez-en davantage sur la vie chez Palantir et notez que nos offres peuvent varier selon les régions.

Conformément aux valeurs et à la culture de Palantir, nous estimons que les employés sont « meilleurs ensemble » et que le travail en présentiel permet d’obtenir des résultats plus créatifs. En conséquence, nous encourageons les employés à travailler depuis nos bureaux pour favoriser la connectivité et l’innovation. De nombreuses équipes proposent des options hybrides (télétravail un jour ou deux par semaine), ce qui permet à nos employés de trouver le bon compromis pour leur productivité personnelle. En fonction des besoins de l’entreprise, il existe quelques postes qui permettent de travailler « à distance » de manière exceptionnelle. Si vous postulez à l’un de ces postes, vous devez travailler depuis la ville et/ou le pays dans lequel vous êtes employé(e). Si le poste précise « sur site », vous devez travailler depuis un bureau.

Si vous souhaitez donner aux organisations les plus importantes au monde les moyens d’agir, votre place est ici. Palantir valorise l’excellence, d’où qu’elle vienne. Nous nous engageons à rendre le processus de candidature et d’embauche accessible à tous et offrirons des aménagements raisonnables aux personnes vivant en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement pour le processus de candidature ou d’embauche, veuillez nous contacter et nous indiquer comment nous pouvons vous aider.

Attention : il ne vous sera jamais demandé d’envoyer un paiement ou de partager des données financières pour participer à notre processus d’entretien. Si vous pensez avoir été contacté par un escroc, nous vous conseillons de cesser toute communication avec la personne et d’envisager de la signaler aux autorités compétentes, telles que l’Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) du FBI aux États-Unis.

postings.title: DevOps Engineer

postings.content:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
 
The Role
 
The Palantir platform is deployed in numerous critical mission environments including combat zones and classified networks—from the back of a Humvee to a command post to the cloud. This means operating in multiple cloud environments, on-prem air-gapped networks, and at the edge—at scale.

We are looking for Edge Infrastructure Engineers to build, operate, and maintain high-performance, scalable, and reliable services for our production infrastructure. This role demands a deep focus on low-level systems, including the deployment and management of physical bare metal servers in both traditional data centers and edge environments. You will be responsible for physical network engineering and the development of robust infrastructure that ensures performance of the Palantir platform.

In addition to ensuring performance and reliability, you will play a critical role in building and scaling new environments in a forward-deployed capacity, including onsite. Edge Infrastructure Engineers combine hardware-level engineering experience with the drive to improve existing systems and the creativity to develop novel solutions for evolving challenges. Our team strives to automate processes wherever possible, using whichever tools are best for the job.

We strongly believe in engineering teams being responsible for the operations of their services in production. In this role, you’ll work closely with engineers to advocate for and participate in sensible, scalable systems design, sharing responsibility for diagnosing, resolving, and preventing production issues across our most demanding deployments.
 
Core Responsibilities 
 
Maintaining availability of cloud & physical Kubernetes servers that power the Palantir platform in air-gapped production environments.
Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure to support customer & product requirements via modern orchestration & monitoring platforms.
Collaborate closely with product teams on requirements & SLOs for deploying software into air-gapped environments.
Identifying, troubleshooting, and solving network & systems issues.
Scripting to automate away routine operational tasks.
 
What We Value
 
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with multiple different teams spread over a wide geography.
A very high level of independence and resilience with the ability to work remotely with little oversight and guidance.
Ability to effectively support our customers and advise them on hardware purchases, capacity planning, firewalls, etc.
Should have an understanding of how database systems work and how to manage them e.g Oracle, Postgresql. Does not need to be a Database Administrator.
Understanding of Kubernetes, Cassandra, Hadoop, and how distributed systems work in general.
Previous experience with server hardware e.g. Dell, HP, etc as well as network engineering, in production data centre environments.
Solid practical experience of Linux OS, Linux administration, and troubleshooting, as well as familiarity with related tools, such as Logical Volume Manager (LVM) commands.
 
What We Require
 
5+ years experience managing medium to large scale systems.
Active clearance or an ability to obtain an active clearance in the country the job is advertised
[20-40% travel]
Availability to work in-office/on-site at our Warsaw location(s) five days a week
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).


Inżynier ds. infrastruktury brzegowej
 
Rola
 
Platforma Palantir jest wdrażana w wielu krytycznych środowiskach realizacji misji, w tym w strefach walki i sieciach niejawnych – od wnętrza Humvee, przez stanowisko dowodzenia, aż po chmurę. Oznacza to działanie w wielu środowiskach chmurowych, w odizolowanych sieciach lokalnych (air-gapped) oraz na brzegu sieci – na dużą skalę.
Poszukujemy inżynierów infrastruktury brzegowej do tworzenia, obsługi i utrzymywania wydajnych, skalowalnych i niezawodnych usług dla naszej infrastruktury produkcyjnej. Ta rola wymaga głębokiego skupienia na systemach niskiego poziomu, w tym na wdrażaniu i zarządzaniu fizycznymi serwerami bare metal zarówno w tradycyjnych centrach danych, jak i w środowiskach brzegowych. Będziesz odpowiadać za fizyczną inżynierię sieci oraz rozwój solidnej infrastruktury zapewniającej wydajność platformy Palantir.
Oprócz zapewnienia wydajności i niezawodności będziesz odgrywać kluczową rolę w budowaniu i skalowaniu nowych środowisk w ramach działań prowadzonych bezpośrednio u klienta, w tym na miejscu. Inżynierowie infrastruktury brzegowej łączą doświadczenie inżynieryjne na poziomie sprzętu z dążeniem do ulepszania istniejących systemów i kreatywnością w opracowywaniu nowych rozwiązań dla zmieniających się wyzwań. Nasz zespół dąży do automatyzacji procesów wszędzie tam, gdzie to możliwe, przy użyciu narzędzi, które najlepiej sprawdzają się w danym zadaniu.
Głęboko wierzymy, że zespoły inżynieryjne powinny być odpowiedzialne za operacyjne utrzymanie swoich usług w środowisku produkcyjnym. W tej roli będziesz ściśle współpracować z inżynierami, aby promować i uczestniczyć w rozsądnym, skalowalnym projektowaniu systemów, współdzieląc odpowiedzialność za diagnozowanie, rozwiązywanie i zapobieganie problemom produkcyjnym w naszych najbardziej wymagających wdrożeniach.
 
Podstawowe obowiązki
 
Utrzymanie dostępności chmurowych i fizycznych serwerów Kubernetes, które zasilają platformę Palantir w odizolowanych (air-gapped) środowiskach produkcyjnych.
Projektowanie, wdrażanie i obsługa infrastruktury w celu spełniania wymagań klientów i produktów za pośrednictwem nowoczesnych platform orkiestracji i monitorowania.
Ścisła współpraca z zespołami produktowymi w zakresie wymagań i SLO dotyczących wdrażania oprogramowania w odizolowanych (air-gapped) środowiskach.
Identyfikowanie, diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów z siecią i systemami.
Tworzenie skryptów w celu automatyzacji rutynowych zadań operacyjnych.
 
Co sobie cenimy
 
Umiejętność efektywnej współpracy i komunikacji z wieloma różnymi zespołami rozproszonymi na dużym obszarze geograficznym.
Bardzo wysoki poziom niezależności i odporności oraz umiejętność pracy zdalnej przy niewielkim nadzorze i wsparciu.
Umiejętność skutecznego wspierania naszych klientów i doradzania im w zakresie zakupu sprzętu, planowania pojemności, zapór sieciowych itp.
Rozumienie, jak działają systemy baz danych i jak nimi zarządzać, np. Oracle, PostgreSQL. Nie ma konieczności bycia administratorem baz danych.
Zrozumienie Kubernetes, Cassandra, Hadoop oraz ogólnego działania systemów rozproszonych.
Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w pracy ze sprzętem serwerowym, np. Dell, HP itp., a także w inżynierii sieciowej w środowiskach produkcyjnych centrów danych.
Solidne praktyczne doświadczenie w zakresie systemu Linux, administracji systemem Linux i rozwiązywania problemów, a także znajomość powiązanych narzędzi, takich jak polecenia Logical Volume Manager (LVM).
 
Wymagania
Ponad 5 lat doświadczenia w zarządzaniu systemami średniej i dużej skali.
Aktywne poświadczenie bezpieczeństwa lub możliwość uzyskania aktywnego poświadczenia bezpieczeństwa w kraju, w którym ogłoszono ofertę pracy
[20-40% czasu w podróży]
Gotowość do pracy stacjonarnej w biurze w Warszawie lub u klienta przez pięć dni w tygodniu.
 
Życie w Palantir
 
Chcemy, aby każdy z pracowników firmy Palantir osiągał najlepsze wyniki, dlatego doceniamy mocne strony, umiejętności i zainteresowania poszczególnych osób od pierwszej rozmowy kwalifikacyjnej po długoterminowy rozwój, zamiast polegać na tradycyjnych drabinach kariery. Zwracanie uwagi na potrzeby naszej społeczności umożliwia nam optymalizację naszych możliwości rozwoju i pomaga zapewnić wiele dróg do sukcesu w Palantir. Promowanie zdrowia i dobrego samopoczucia we wszystkich obszarach życia pracowników firmy Palantir to tylko jeden ze sposobów inwestowania w naszą społeczność. Dowiedz się więcej na stronie Życie w Palantir i pamiętaj, że nasza oferta może się różnić w zależności od regionu.

Wierzymy, że postępowanie zgodne z wartościami i kulturą firmy Palantir sprawia, iż pracownicy „lepiej współpracują ze sobą”, a praca osobista daje możliwość bardziej kreatywnych wyników. Dlatego zachęcamy pracowników do pracy w naszych biurach, aby wspierać powiązania i innowacje. Wiele zespołów oferuje opcje hybrydowe (dzień lub dwa dni w tygodniu pracy w domu), dzięki czemu nasi pracownicy mogą uzyskać odpowiedni kompromis dla swojej osobistej produktywności. W zależności od potrzeb biznesowych istnieje kilka ról, które pozwalają na „zdalną” pracę w wyjątkowych warunkach. Jeśli ubiegasz się o jedno z tych stanowisk, musisz pracować w mieście i kraju, w którym jesteś zatrudniony. Jeśli oferta w ogłoszeniu jest określona jako „na miejscu”, musisz pracować w biurze.

Jeśli chcesz wzmacniać najważniejsze instytucje świata, jest to miejsce dla Ciebie. Palantir ceni doskonałość niezależnie od pochodzenia. Dokładamy wszelkich starań, aby proces składania aplikacji i zatrudniania był dostępny dla wszystkich, oraz zapewnimy odpowiednie udogodnienia osobom z niepełnosprawnością. Jeśli potrzebujesz udogodnienia w procesie aplikacji lub zatrudnienia, skontaktuj się z nami i daj nam znać, jak możemy Ci pomóc.

Pamiętaj, że nigdy nie zostaniesz poproszony(-a) o przesłanie płatności lub udostępnienie informacji finansowych w celu wzięcia udziału w naszym procesie rekrutacyjnym. Jeśli podejrzewasz, że skontaktował się z Tobą oszust, zalecamy zaprzestanie wszelkiej komunikacji z taką osobą i rozważenie zgłoszenia jej odpowiednim organom, takim jak amerykańskie Centrum ds. Zgłaszania Przestępstw Internetowych (IC3) przy FBI (FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

By connecting the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to revitalize American industrial production, develop lifesaving drugs, protect our Warfighters, and more. The Role   Palantir's Mixed Reality Group (MRG) is a Tier 1 team of researchers, 3D artists, immersive UX designers, and cross-discipline engineers to bring the most exquisite software of our time to the factory floor, the battlefield, and the briefing room. You will collaborate with customers, operators, MR designers, and MR developers to deliver force-multiplying apps that exceed tomorrow’s requirements today.   The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer   At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.   FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.   You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.   Core Responsibilities   As an MR FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:   • Hands-on work with cutting edge Mixed Reality hardware. Deploying builds, configuring devices, building and testing new integrations • Troubleshoot issues at all layers of the system, from physical to application • Architect, develop, debug, document, and deploy performant Mixed Reality applications • Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions • Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations • Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs • Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives • Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value Technologies We Use

  • Android tools (Android Studio, adb, etc.)
  • Unity

  • Challenging dogma, fighting fixed mindsets, burning down bureaucracy at every opportunity
  • Understanding of Defense and Intel industry product lifecycles
  • Strong programming skills with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, or similar.

  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Rust, Go, or similar.

  • Engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science
